fact: The PRISE 2026-2028 programme document (February 2026, revised March 2026) states SIGE is functional and comprehensive with data by sex, age, location and school type, and plans a SABER-EMIS diagnostic and modernisation plan.
title: PROGRAMA DE SUPORTE AO REFORÇO INSTITUCIONAL DO SECTOR EDUCATIVO (PRISE) 2026-2028
